speaker: abel_garnish
text: The garden. The queen's entrance. Kemp is not on the plot, and I have not sent for him.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave him off it. This pass is hers and Tom's.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Where do I stand, Master Shakespeare? If I stand in the middle, nobody is overhearing me. I am only arriving.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou standest where the trees would take thee, Nick. Not in the open. She comes in to hear, and the yard must see that she thinks she is hidden.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: And I am the man she is hidden from, until I am not. If I plant myself on the trap, the boy will have to shout, and then we are both in the wrong play.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou hast given the garden to the boy and to Tom, and left the king in the tiring-house with his hands empty.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The king is not in this garden, Dick. If I put thee in it, the queen is no longer overhearing a gardener. She is overhearing a play about herself, and she will know it.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then give me the next one. I will not stand in a door for a scene I am not in, not with sixteen days between me and a yard.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Sixteen days. Thou wilt have the yard. This morning thou wilt let Nick find the shadow.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I can do it quieter. Last week I was told that is the part. I have not forgotten.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Quieter, aye. And breathe before it, not in it. The line will wait for thee.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Shall I have a laugh, or am I only the hedge?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You are the hedge that talks, Tom. One laugh, if it comes out of the work, and not one you go looking for.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: I am writing no margin for a laugh that has not happened. And I am writing no fool. If Master Kemp asks, the plot will answer him.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: He will ask. He asks when he is not in the room, which is a talent.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the plot may answer him. I am not putting a fool in this king to keep the peace.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: I did not ask for the garden. I asked not to be furniture.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Thou art not furniture. Thou art the man this scene is about, who is not allowed to hear it. That is the harder part, and it is not played today.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: Shall I go again from the entrance?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: From the entrance. Stop where the shadow would be. If thou canst not find it, Tom will tell thee, and I will believe Tom.

speaker: thomas_pope
text: Two paces left of the post, lad, and then be still. I will speak as if I had not seen thee. That is the whole of my cunning.

speaker: nick_sorrell
text: I have it. Two paces. I will not look at you when you say it.

speaker: abel_garnish
text: Sixteen days on the book, and the queen's roll is clean. I have copied nothing into a margin this morning, and I am glad of the nothing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Keep it clean, Abel. We go once more, and then the hired men may have the door back.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Once more, then. I will sit on the stair and hate it honestly, which is all the use thou hast left me.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Hate it from the stair, Dick. Not from the garden.
